thread:
Evan T.: Hi finance team, urgent-ish question. I bought a local SIM + eSIM activation in Manila for a customer visit. Merchant charged the corp card 1200 PHP but only gave a handwritten receipt. No VAT invoice. Can we still expense this?
Kira (Finance): Hey @Evan. We need a proper merchant invoice for foreign telecom purchases when amounts > $50 USD equivalent. 1200 PHP is about $20 USD though. Do you have a screenshot of the POS transaction or the vendor's registered business name/Tax ID?
Evan T.: I have a photo of the handwritten receipt and the seller's stall name: "TNT SIM KIOSK - MNL". No tax ID on the slip. I also have the eSIM confirmation email from the carrier with transaction id: TXN-PL-9987. Uploaded: receipt.jpg -> https://redwood-files/receipts/sim_1845001111.jpg ; esim_email.pdf -> https://redwood-files/receipts/esim_1845001111.pdf
expense-bot: For non-invoice receipts under the policy threshold, submit an expense with a short attestation:```/expenses submit
amount: 1200 PHP (approx 19.80 USD)
category: travel - telecom
attach: receipt.jpg, esim_email.pdf
notes: "Local SIM + eSIM activation for customer visit in MNL. Vendor unregistered. Attestation: purchase necessary for connectivity; no VAT invoice available."```
Kira (Finance): Thanks. Because this is under $50 USD, we can approve with manager sign-off and a short attestation. We still prefer a vendor tax ID when available, but small local vendor cases are allowed if you provide the email transaction and a photo. Please include the USD equivalent from your bank statement.
Evan T.: The card posted 19.83 USD. I attached a screenshot of the card-line in the app: card_txn.png -> https://redwood-files/receipts/card_txn_1845001111.png
Derek S.: I approve this purchase for business. Evan had to be reachable for the customer demo.
Kira (Finance): Approved then. One more note: eSIM activations that create recurring subscriptions must be flagged as subscriptions. This one is a one-time activation per the carrier receipt, so treat as travel telecom. If the carrier charges monthly later, tag finance asap and we'll move it to vendor subscription onboarding.
corp-card-bot: Unusual vendor: vendor not in vendor-registry. Status: manual-review -> /expenses view 1845001111
Evan T.: Submitted per the template and tagged @Derek and @Kira. Thanks for the quick help!
Kira (Finance): Received. I'll mark as approved and reimburse the USD 19.83 on next payroll run. Closing thread once posted. :white_check_mark:
